name: frigate
description: A complete and local NVR designed for Home Assistant with AI object detection. Uses OpenCV and Tensorflow to perform realtime object detection locally for IP cameras. You can use an integrated or dedicated GPU (Intel/AMD/Nvidia) to decode your cameras' streams, and a detector such as a Google Coral, Hailo, OpenVINO (Intel GPU/NPU), an Nvidia GPU (TensorRT) or an AMD GPU (ROCm) for object detection. This is a general template: check every option and remove the devices and variables you are not going to use. Frigate creates a default config file in the config folder on first start. The WebUI uses https with a self-signed certificate; the admin password is printed in the container log on first start. Documentation: https://docs.frigate.video/

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Authenticated UI and API (https, self-signed certificate by default). Reverse proxies should use this port.

ports.name: RTSP Restreaming Port
ports.description: Unauthenticated by default; authentication can be set in the go2rtc section of the config.

ports.name: WebRTC TCP Port
ports.description: Low latency live views and two-way talk.

ports.name: WebRTC UDP Port
ports.description: Low latency live views and two-way talk.

variables.name: Frigate RTSP Password
variables.description: Optional: use it in your config as {FRIGATE_RTSP_PASSWORD} to keep camera passwords out of the file.

variables.name: Intel/AMD GPU Driver
variables.description: iHD for recent Intel, i965 for older Intel, radeonsi for AMD. Remove this if you are not using it.

variables.name: Nvidia Visible Devices
variables.description: Only for Nvidia: your GPU UUID, shown in the Nvidia Driver plugin. Remove this if you are not using it.

variables.name: Nvidia Driver Capabilities
variables.description: Only for Nvidia. Remove this if you are not using it.

devices.name: Coral / Hailo Mapping
devices.description: /dev/bus/usb for a USB Coral, /dev/apex_0 for a PCIe Coral (drivers first), /dev/hailo0 for Hailo. Remove this if you are not using it.

devices.name: Intel/AMD GPU Mapping
devices.description: Intel/AMD GPU for decoding (and OpenVINO detection on Intel). Remove this if you are not using it.
